name: Grom’tor Torn-heart
shortDescription: Oronok’s living son, who pursues the first Cipher fragment at Coilskar Point.
body: Oronok’s living son, who pursues the first Cipher fragment at Coilskar Point. Visual details are original generated research art, not canonical model evidence. Composition, markings, costume and exact game resemblance await human comparison with the target Burning Crusade client.
